verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows built-in AI that drafts or refines subject lines or email copy from a brief inside the composer. The drafting claims (docs-1, docs-16, docs-41) describe external AI clients driving Customer.io through the MCP server or CLI, which is a developer and integration route, not an in-composer feature. The built-in agent is documented only for adjacent tasks: describing segments, analyzing the workspace, scheduled routines, Slack, and AI-generated global styles.
